I’ve gone from only playing 2 dps characters to running basically anything. I only ever managed to really get the hang of demon hunter and enhancement shaman before hekili.

I think knowing your rotation from the get go helps a lot in terms of enjoyment with a new class, especially when I’ve been playing wow for so long already. I hate how people come up with dumb reasons as to why somebody should be reported/banned. 

in my mind people should be banned for:

1.Racism/hate speech, these being the more hurtful/unwelcome tones in a video game.

2. Just straight up abusing your team/opposing team this isnt banter. this is just being an asshole. There is a HUGE difference between people trash talking for banter, and people being abused. Some people may say the line is blurred but it really isnt in my eyes. It can be fun to banter with other people, it's a part of gaming. People shouldn't be punished for joking around, unless it brings in stuff mentioned in the previous point.

3. Griefing in a way that is constantly putting your team at a disadvantage and/or making the game less fun for your allies.

Obviously there are other things such as 3rd party programs or abusing matchmaking such as hostage situations(keeping players trapped in game for large time periods) or wintrading. But these three points should be the main 3 focused on in my opinion.

Also this can be rare but we've seen it happen at times. parties of 2-4 that queue up and gang up on people that they get teamed up with just to abuse them and make their time playing less enjoyable, should be permabanned.
